notes: Canadian dollars per US dollar, as e in the book (a rise is a depreciation of the Canadian dollar); the chapter's figure plots 100 divided by these numbers, the US-cent price of the Canadian dollar. The two bill yields are not measured alike (Canada: the last Thursday of each month, or weekly tenders before 1954; the United States: new issues within the year). The US column is read from the text layer of the scan (PDF page 273, printed page 265), the first figure of each year's line; it agrees with the rows quoted in mundell_facts.
